sanskrit: yās te śataṃ dhamanayaḥ sahasrāṇī ca viṃśatiḥ | babhror aśvasya vāreṇa- -api nahyāmi tā aham ||
english: Those hundred channels of yours, and twenty thousands — with the hair of a brown horse I bind them all closed.

sanskrit: śatasya te dhamanīnāṃ sahasrasyāyutasya ca | dṛteḥ pādam iva sārathir api nahyāmi yad bilam ||
english: Of your hundred channels, of your thousand, of your ten-thousand — just as a charioteer ties shut the leg of a leather bag, so I bind shut whatever opening there is.

sanskrit: paramasyāṃ parāvati śuṣko bhaṇḍuś ca tiṣṭhataḥ | tataḥ śuṣkasya śuṣmeṇa tiṣṭhantu lohinīr apaḥ ||
english: In the farthest distant place, Śuṣka (Dryness) and Bhaṇḍu stand firm. By the drying power of that Dryness, let the bleeding waters stand still.

sanskrit: pari vaḥ sikatāmayaṃ maruṃ bile vapāmasi | yakac cid asravīt purā takac cid aśamīd idam ||
english: Around you we press a sand-made plug into the opening. Whatever flowed out before — that this charm has stilled.

sanskrit: rudra mā tvā jīhiḍāma suṣṭutyā maghavan mā sahūtyā | bhiṣaktamaṃ tvā bhiṣajāṃ śṛṇomy un no vīrām̐ īraya bheṣajebhiḥ ||
english: O Rudra, may we not offend you through our praise, O Maghavan, nor through our joint invocation. I hear you as the most excellent physician among physicians — rouse up our heroes with your remedies.

sanskrit: rudra yat te guhyaṃ nāma yat te addhātayo viduḥ | śivā śaravyā yā tava tayā no mṛḍa jīvase ||
english: O Rudra, that secret name of yours which the addhātayas know — by that auspicious missile of yours, show us mercy, grant us life.

sanskrit: agniṃ tvāhur vaiśvānaraṃ sadanān pradahan v agāḥ | sa no devatrādhi brūhi mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
english: They call you Agni Vaiśvānara; you have gone forth burning the dwellings. Speak over us to the gods — may we who are yours not be harmed.

sanskrit: yā devaiḥ prahiteṣuḥ patāt tapase vā mahase vāvasṛṣṭā | somas tvām asmad yāvayatu vidvān avantu naḥ pitaro devahūtiṣu ||
english: That missile which flies, launched by the gods, released for its heat or its might — may wise Soma drive it away from us; may the Fathers protect us at the invocations of the gods.

sanskrit: rāyaspoṣaṃ dhehi no jātaveda ūrjāvad agne yaśaḥ sūnṛtāvat | dadhāma bhāgaṃ sunavāma somaṃ yajñena tvām upa śikṣema śakra ||
english: O Jātavedas, grant us the flourishing of wealth, vigour-filled; O Agni, glory filled with truth. We lay down our portion, we press the Soma — O Mighty One, may we serve you through sacrifice.

sanskrit: vayam agne dhanavantaḥ syāma- -alaṃ yajñāyota dakṣiṇāyai | grāvā vaded abhi somasyāṃśūn endraṃ śikṣemendunā sutena ||
english: O Agni, may we be wealthy, adequate for sacrifice and for the sacrificial fee. Let the pressing stone resound over the shoots of the Soma — may we serve Indra with the pressed drop.

sanskrit: īśānaṃ tvā śuśrumā vayaṃ puro dhanānāṃ dhanapate | gomad agne aśvavad bhūri puṣṭaṃ hiraṇyavad annavad dhehi mahyam ||
english: We have heard you as the ruler, the vanguard of riches, O Lord of wealth — O Agni, grant me abundant nourishment: rich in cattle, rich in horses, rich in gold, rich in food.

sanskrit: duhāṃ me dyauḥ pṛthivī payo 'jagaro mā sodako 'bhi vi sarpatu | prajāpatinā tanvam ā prīṇe 'riṣṭo ma ātmā ||
english: May Heaven and Earth milk out nourishment for me; let no serpent nor water-creature creep upon me. By Prajāpati I fill my body — unharmed is my self.
